name: Task Conflict Safety & Agent API Permissions
objectives: Validate concurrent task claims return 409 conflict response
Validate first-claimer-wins semantics for task checkout
Validate stale version updates are rejected with conflict error
Validate agents can read their assigned tasks via API key
Validate agents can update task status through valid transitions
Validate agents can add comments to assigned tasks
Validate agents can report costs via API key
Validate agents cannot access other company data (403)
Validate invalid status transitions are rejected
